mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material_return_receive ( application_content_id, application_id, product_id, vault, handle_type, return_qty, continue_purchase, handle_remark, return_qtyed ) VALUES ( #{applicationContentId}, #{applicationId}, #{productId}, #{vault}, #{handleType}, #{returnQty}, 3, #{handleRemark}, 0 )
mapper.select:
SELECT id, parentId, name, url, material_number, brand, description, number, vault, deleteSign, unit, priceUnit FROM product WHERE (id, vault) IN
(#{MaterialReturnReceives.productId}, #{MaterialReturnReceives.vault})
UNION ALL
SELECT id AS id, fin_sort_id AS parentId, fin_product_name AS name, url AS url, fin_material_number AS material_number, price AS brand, fin_description AS description, fin_number AS number, vault AS vault, deleteSign AS deleteSign, unit AS unit, priceUnit AS priceUnit FROM fin_product WHERE (id, vault) IN
(#{MaterialReturnReceives.productId}, #{MaterialReturnReceives.vault})

SELECT r.*,
COALESCE(p.parentId, f.fin_sort_id) AS parentId, COALESCE(p.name, f.fin_product_name) AS name, COALESCE(p.url, f.url) AS url, COALESCE(p.material_number, f.fin_material_number) AS material_number, COALESCE(p.brand, f.price) AS brand, COALESCE(p.description, f.fin_description) AS description, COALESCE(p.number, f.fin_number) AS number,
COALESCE(p.unit, f.unit) AS unit, COALESCE(p.priceUnit, f.priceUnit) AS priceUnit
FROM material_return_receive r
LEFT JOIN product p ON r.product_id = p.id AND r.vault = p.vault
LEFT JOIN fin_product f ON r.product_id = f.id AND r.vault = f.vault
WHERE r.handle_type = 2 AND LENGTH(material_number) > 0
ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.receive_user = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, r.handle_time DESC
-- 分页：第 pageNum 页，每页 pageSize 条 LIMIT #{page}, #{pageSize}

COALESCE(p.unit, f.unit) AS unit, COALESCE(p.priceUnit, f.priceUnit) AS priceUnit
FROM material_return_receive r

LEFT JOIN fin_product f ON r.product_id = f.id AND r.vault = f.vault
WHERE r.handle_type = 2 AND LENGTH(material_number) > 0

SELECT r.*,
COALESCE(p.parentId, f.fin_sort_id) AS parentId, COALESCE(p.name, f.fin_product_name) AS name, COALESCE(p.url, f.url) AS url, COALESCE(p.material_number, f.fin_material_number) AS material_number, COALESCE(p.brand, f.price) AS brand, COALESCE(p.description, f.fin_description) AS description, COALESCE(p.number, f.fin_number) AS number,
COALESCE(p.unit, f.unit) AS unit, COALESCE(p.priceUnit, f.priceUnit) AS priceUnit
FROM material_return_receive r
LEFT JOIN product p ON r.product_id = p.id AND r.vault = p.vault
LEFT JOIN fin_product f ON r.product_id = f.id AND r.vault = f.vault
WHERE r.handle_type = 1 AND LENGTH(material_number) > 0
